productionTraining.title: Mechanical faults in rotating machinery dataset (normal, unbalance, misalignment, looseness)
productionTraining.acquisition: 20 independently reset physical tests, 5 per condition; 4 accelerometers; 25 kHz; approximately 1238 RPM
productionTraining.use: Production classifier training and whole-test held-out validation
productionTraining.changes: Deterministic 8,192-sample windows and RotorNote 48-feature vectors derived from selected raw recordings.

variableSpeedAnomalyTraining.title: UPATRAS Rotating Machinery Vibration Dataset for Incipient Fault Diagnosis under Varying Rotating Speeds
variableSpeedAnomalyTraining.acquisition: 39 independent measurement sequences; 2,925 single-axis vibration signals; 1,024 Hz; 75 rotating speeds from 35.0 to 49.8 Hz; healthy plus seven incipient fault states.
variableSpeedAnomalyTraining.use: Production variable-speed neural head with an eight-condition learned representation, a healthy-versus-anomaly product boundary, and whole-measurement-sequence grouped validation.
variableSpeedAnomalyTraining.changes: Two deterministic 2,048-sample windows per signal and RotorNote 48-feature vectors. Source sequence names preserve all eight observed laboratory conditions for representation learning; the product output collapses them to healthy versus observed anomaly without presenting laboratory condition names as field diagnoses.

bearingBoundaryEvaluation.title: Vibration Data for Axial Ball Bearings and Spall Faults
bearingBoundaryEvaluation.acquisition: 28 single-axis vibration records from a separate physical axial-bearing rig; 25.6 kHz for 30 seconds; 60 or 500 RPM; 5.0 or 8.8 kN axial load; four healthy captures plus 24 artificially seeded inner/outer race spalls across six fault sizes.
bearingBoundaryEvaluation.use: Full-archive external boundary evaluation through the canonical one-channel anomaly route only; never production training.

zhenjiangBoundaryEvaluation.title: Zhenjiang bearing dataset
zhenjiangBoundaryEvaluation.acquisition: Separate physical bearing rig; 25.6 kHz; five numbered condition files (healthy, inner race, outer race, ball, ball-plus-outer-race); seven documented speeds from 900 to 1500 RPM; 1,800 samples per time-domain trace.
zhenjiangBoundaryEvaluation.use: Second-rig external fail-closed challenge through the canonical one-channel anomaly route only; never production training.

imsNaturalFailureBoundary.title: IMS Bearing Data Set
imsNaturalFailureBoundary.publisher: NASA Prognostics Center of Excellence Data Set Repository
imsNaturalFailureBoundary.license: NASA Open Data marks access as public and links the USA.gov government-works notice; original provider is IMS, University of Cincinnati
imsNaturalFailureBoundary.acquisition: Three test-to-failure experiments; four bearings per shaft at 2,000 RPM and 6,000 lb radial load; 20 kHz one-second snapshots; eight accelerometer channels in set 1 and four in sets 2 and 3; documented natural end-state failures in four bearing installations.
imsNaturalFailureBoundary.use: Natural run-to-failure, multi-bearing, multi-sensor external fail-closed boundary evaluation only; never production training.
